\begin{tablenotes}\footnotesize
\item Launched-item outcome: NDCG@10 and Recall@10 over users whose test interactions include a launched product, truth restricted to launched products; values are medians over contexts after averaging launch sets within a context. +Foreign: model fitted on local plus all same-category foreign training data. $-$Chance: paired difference model+foreign minus the random ranker, median over contexts with a two-way (country, category) cluster-bootstrap 95\% CI. $>$Chance+0.01: contexts where that difference exceeds 0.01 (in parentheses: the same count for the local-only model). Overall change: NDCG@10 over all test users (full test truth, at most 20,000 users), foreign minus local only. Gain vs local: launched-item NDCG@10, foreign minus local only (median; local-only scores are near zero by construction). Tuning zf: hyperparameters selected on validation interactions with non-launched products only (strictly zero local feedback on launched products); vf: selected on the hidden validation interactions with launched products. Either needs $\geq$10 validation users, otherwise the first grid setting is used. Random/temporal: 3 launch sets per context, 30\% of eligible products (local training interactions and foreign training interactions, chosen without the test set). Calendar: products outside the pre-cutoff local catalog (not retained by the pre-cutoff core filter) that are in a foreign pre-cutoff catalog and have a local interaction after the validation cutoff. EASE skips catalogs over 4,000 products. Common context set (all five models available): Random 70, Temporal 69, Calendar 42.
\end{tablenotes}
\end{threeparttable}
